blueprint_note: none.jpg is a gray 'None' placeholder card with NO tech-pack drawing. Geometry is locked to the bias_cutting family base drawing (bias_cutting/inner-collar-stand.jpg: shirt buttoned to the top with the single collar-stand button FASTENED, worn without tie, inner collar-stand band revealed at the back neck by the slightly elevated viewpoint, standard sewn placket with two topstitch rows) with ALL red diagonal bias hatching removed.
view: Front view, camera slightly above collar level angled gently down; collar-stand button fastened (shirt buttoned to the top), no tie; the downward angle looks into the neckline so the inner face of the collar stand at the back of the neck is clearly visible; detail-dominant crop from mid-chest up. Mirrors the inner-collar-stand sibling composition for direct side-by-side comparison.

geometry.fabric: Fine blue-and-white bengal/candy stripe cotton poplin, ~3 mm stripes / ~6 mm repeat — required because straight vs bias grain is invisible on solid white.
geometry.grain: EVERY pattern piece cut on the straight grain. Stripes run perfectly vertical on the body, front placket, outer collar leaf, outer collar stand, and the exposed INNER collar-stand band. Zero components show 45-degree diagonal stripes.
geometry.collar: Turndown collar, semi-spread points ~7 cm, single-needle edge stitching on leaf and stand edges, exactly ONE button on the collar stand, FASTENED (shirt buttoned to the top, no tie), per family base drawing.
geometry.placket: Standard sewn button placket ~3.5 cm wide with TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and a visible placket button below the stand (per family base drawing; drift lesson applied).
geometry.red_hatching: None anywhere — the family's red hatching convention marks bias components; this option has no bias component and must contain no red marks and no diagonal grain.

ratios: collar_stand_height (3.5 cm) is approximately 6 stripe repeats tall
locked_features: Blue-and-white bengal stripe shirting throughout (never solid white)
Straight-grain vertical stripes on ALL components including the inner collar-stand band
No diagonal / 45-degree stripe direction anywhere in frame
Collar-stand button fastened, no tie, inner collar-stand band face revealed at the back neck by the elevated camera angle
Standard placket: two parallel vertical topstitch rows + visible button
Exactly one collar-stand button; mother-of-pearl buttons
No red color, no annotation text, no arrows or dimension marks
distinguishes_from_siblings: bias-inner-collar-stand shows 45-degree diagonal stripes ONLY on the exposed inner collar-stand band; bias-inner-top-collar shows diagonal stripes ONLY on the underside of the top collar; bias-inner-cuff shows diagonal stripes ONLY on the inner cuff face. bias-none is the baseline: identical framing, but every visible piece — inner band included — carries vertical straight-grain stripes with no diagonal anywhere.
